criteria.title: Spatial orbit and bay copy
criteria.observation: CopyBay portal journey builds a spatial frame, analyses My/Mz/T and round-trips export.

criteria.title: Separate model/analysis Workers and cancel
criteria.observation: Cancel restores the model; a superseded solve never becomes Current after edits.

criteria.title: Skewed and asymmetric OpenSees pack
criteria.observation: S01 skewed spatial frame and S02 asymmetric portal match the OpenSees pack on this build.

criteria.title: 5,000-node multibay solve and memory guard
criteria.observation: Connected 5k-node frame solves under the median gate; tight MEMORY_LIMIT refuses high-fill.

criteria.title: All-axis unit-action tests
criteria.observation: Tip unit loads recover tip end actions with root lever balance and section@0 = −q_i.

criteria.title: Member reversal and roll
criteria.observation: Endpoint reversal remains covered by m01 invariance; localY roll swaps My/Mz and halves tip uz.

criteria.title: Section-axis editing
criteria.observation: Property-form localY edit re-analyses with swapped end moments in the forces table.

criteria.title: Physical-to-analytical mapping UI
criteria.observation: Split children group under physical parent in the model tree with inspector lineage.

limitations: Bounded spatial-building-frame parent; no commercial equivalence claim.
